instruction: Extract the audio from 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp4' located on my Desktop, convert it to MP3 format, and save it as 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' on the Desktop, ensuring good audio quality and reasonable file size.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires extracting audio from MP4 to MP3 using VLC and comprehensively verifying the output. The evaluator performs 8 verification checks: (1) file exists, (2) file is MP3 format (via 'file' command), (3) file contains valid audio stream, (4) audio codec is MP3-compatible, (5) file size is between 1MB and 10MB, (6) audio has valid duration, (7) audio duration matches source video (within 5% tolerance or 2 seconds), and (8) audio has reasonable sample rate (>=22kHz). The getter uses 'file' command for format detection and ffprobe to extract detailed audio metadata including codec, duration, sample rate, and bit rate. It also compares the MP3 duration with the source MP4 video to verify the audio was actually extracted from the correct source. This comprehensive verification ensures proper audio extraction, correct format, and preservation of quality.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator comprehensively verifies all instruction requirements through 8 verification checks
Audio extraction verified: duration matching check (Check 7) confirms MP3 duration matches source video within 5% tolerance or 2 seconds, proving audio was actually extracted from the source video
MP3 format verified: Check 2 uses 'file' command to verify file type contains 'MPEG' and 'audio', Check 4 verifies codec is MP3-compatible (mp3/mp2/mp1/mpeg1audio/mpeg2audio)
Audio content verified: Check 3 confirms file contains valid audio stream via ffprobe, Check 6 verifies non-zero duration
Quality preservation verified: Check 5 verifies reasonable file size (1-10 MB), Check 8 verifies sample rate >= 22kHz (minimum for decent quality)
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements (extract audio + convert to MP3 + preserve quality) are semantically verified
Robust implementation: Uses industry-standard tools (file command, ffprobe) for verification, proper error handling, smart tolerance for duration matching
Correct data flow: Getter extracts comprehensive audio info, metric receives rules dict directly via get_rule (expected.type='rule'), all parameter handling is correct
